---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_max(career_home_runs, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  left_join(People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast), by = "playerID") |>
  transmute(
    player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    career_home_runs
  )
```
